source:
@@U03807@@
The young ones I'll surprise, and you
graybeards down there, too, sitting around
awaiting the solution to these
not impossible miracles.
All of you, up!
Up! Up! All of you!
Shake your locks!
Rub the sleep from your eyes!
Stop your blinking and listen to me now!

@@U03809@@
Tell us, then, tell us!
Tell us of the marvels that have happened!
We'd most like to hear of things that are
quite unbelievable, for we're bored to death
of looking at these rocks.

@@U03811@@
Bored to death, are you?
And your eyes scarcely wiped of sleep?
All right, then, listen.
Here in these caverns,
these grottoes,
behind these arbors,
our lord and lady have found protection and
security as in some lovers’ idyll.

@@U03813@@
What? In there?

@@U03815@@
Isolated there,
apart from the world,
they called upon me, me only,
to serve them in silence.
Highly honored,
I took up my post quite near them;
MUG, PART INO) 0 Stow
translation:
@@U03807@@
我会让年轻人感到惊讶，而你
下面还有灰胡子，坐在那儿
等待这些问题的解决
并非不可能的奇迹。
你们都起来！
向上！向上！你们所有人！
摇动你的锁！
擦掉眼睛里的睡意！
别眨眼了，现在听我说！

@@U03809@@
那就告诉我们吧，告诉我们吧！
告诉我们发生过的奇迹！
我们最想听到的是
太令人难以置信了，因为我们无聊得要死
看着这些岩石。

@@U03811@@
无聊死了是吗？
你的眼睛几乎没有被睡意擦去吗？
好吧，那么，听着。
在这些洞穴里，
这些石窟，
在这些凉亭后面，
我们的勋爵和夫人已经找到了保护并且
就像一些恋人的田园诗般的安全感。

@@U03813@@
什么？在那里？

@@U03815@@
孤立在那里，
除了这个世界之外，
他们呼唤我，只呼唤我，
默默地为他们服务。
非常荣幸，
我在离他们很近的地方就职了。
马克杯，零件 INO) 0 存放
